options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: cliStatus
options.description: CliStatus query parameter. CLI status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'.

options.name: httpStatus
options.description: HttpStatus query parameter. HTTP staus for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'.

options.name: ipAddress
options.description: IpAddress query parameter. IP Address of the device.

options.name: netconfStatus
options.description: NetconfStatus query parameter. NETCONF status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'.

options.name: pingStatus
options.description: PingStatus query parameter. Ping status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'.

options.name: snmpStatus
options.description: SnmpStatus query parameter. SNMP status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT-PROVIDED' and 'NOT-VALIDATED'.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. Sort by field. Available values are pingStatus, cliStatus,snmpStatus, httpStatus and netconfStatus.

options.name: sortOrder
options.description: SortOrder query parameter. Order of sorting based on sortBy. Available values are 'asc' and 'des'.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
